text: dsh-stage-gate 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 配置提供会话级阶段验收工具。它向工具注册表加入 gate_open、gate_check、gate_list 和 gate_close：可创建带完整验收清单的阶段门，逐项记录 met、unmet 或 n/a 及证据，自动给出通过或阻塞结论，并查看或关闭门。状态按 agent session 保存在内存中，支持配置关闭后的门能否重新检查。适合希望让 agent 按验收标准推进多阶段任务的用户；需先配置 DeepSeek Harness Web 和模型服务。

dsh-stage-gate adds four acceptance tools to DeepSeek Harness Web: create checklists, record met/unmet items with evidence, derive pass or block results, list and close gates. State is held per agent session in memory. It helps agents follow acceptance criteria across work stages.
想让 agent 在每个阶段按验收清单核对工作。
能不能把任务的验收条件逐条标记通过或未通过？
我需要给多阶段流程建立阶段门并查看当前状态。
让 DSH 根据未完成的验收项给出阻塞结论。
如何在一个会话里列出并关闭已经完成的验收门？
希望验收检查可以附上每一项的证据说明。
Track acceptance checklist gates for each agent session.
Have an agent report which acceptance criteria remain unmet.
dsh-stage-gate 的功能「阶段验收清单」：调用 gate_open 建立带标题、阶段名和条目的验收门，条目包含稳定 ID、描述、状态及可选证据。
dsh-stage-gate 的功能「验收并生成结论」：调用 gate_check 提交完整条目列表；任一项未满足时状态为 blocked，否则为 passed，并返回汇总和未满足项。
dsh-stage-gate 的功能「查看会话中的阶段门」：调用 gate_list 查看当前 agent session 中每个门的 ID、标题和生命周期状态。
dsh-stage-gate 的功能「关闭或重新检查」：调用 gate_close 关闭阶段门；allowReopen 配置决定关闭后是否允许再次 gate_check。
dsh-stage-gate 使用前須知：阶段门状态只保存在内存中，DeepSeek Harness 重启后会清空；调用工具还要求存在所属 agent session。

dsh-stage-gate README · dsh-stage-gate：> Stage-gate governance tools for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

Model-callable stage gates: create an acceptance checklist, verify it with evidence, and get a clear **PASS / BLOCK** conclusion — a governance layer for agents that run multi-phase work. State is in-memory, scoped per session.

**English** | [中文](./README.zh.md)

dsh-stage-gate README · What it does：| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `gate_open(gateId, title, stage?, items)` | Create a stage gate with its full acceptance checklist (status `open`). |
| `gate_check(gateId, items)` | Verify the gate: send the ENTIRE item list (whole-value replacement); each item carries `met`/`unmet`/`n/a` and optional `evidence`. The gate is `blocked` while any item is `unmet`, `passed` when all are `met`/`n/a`. |
| `gate_list()` | List every gate in the session with its lifecycle status. |
| `gate_close(gateId, reason?)` | Close a gate (`closed`). A closed gate rejects further `gate_check` unless `allowReopen` is set. |

dsh-stage-gate README · Lifecycle：```
open → in_review → passed   (all items met/n/a)
  │                  │
  │                  └── blocked   (any item unmet) → (allowReopen) → open
  └────────────────────────────→ closed (gate_close)

- `status` on the gate is the lifecycle state machine.
- `conclusion` on the latest `gate/check` records the most recent verification result.

dsh-stage-gate README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-stage-gate
dsh web
```

The tools become model-visible in the Web UI. Model keys and a DeepSeek provider must already be configured (see the [DeepSeek Harness Web UI guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/guide/index.md)).

dsh-stage-gate README · Configuration：`allowReopen` (default `true`): whether a `gate_check` on a `closed` gate is accepted. When `false`, checking a closed gate throws `Error: gate "<id>" is closed`.

Override in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: tool-stage-gate
  config:
    allowReopen: false
```

dsh-stage-gate README · How it works：Gate state is kept **in memory**, scoped per agent session (`gate_open` /
`gate_check` / `gate_close` mutate an in-memory map keyed by session + gate id).

dsh-stage-gate README · How it works：This package deliberately does **not** write custom session events
(`gate/*`). DeepSeek Harness's session persistence refuses to reload a log
containing an event type outside its known-event whitelist unless the event is
marked `ignorable`, and `Session.append` has no API to set that marker. Custom
plugin events would make sessions **unloadable after restart** — see
[`docs/BUG-2026-08-17-session-log-pollution.md`](docs/BUG-2026-08-17-session-log-pollution.md).

dsh-stage-gate README · How it works：**Trade-off:** gate state resets when the harness restarts. This is the correct
cost for an out-of-repo plugin until the harness opens a registration surface
for downstream plugin events.

pnpm test       # vitest (14 tests)
pnpm typecheck  # strict tsc
pnpm build      # emit lib/

dsh-stage-gate README · Compatibility：- Requires DeepSeek Harness `>=0.1.0-rc.5`.
- Web profile only (tools are model-facing).
- Gate state is in-memory and resets on harness restart (see How it works).
